changes.reason: Unambiguous contraction in 'The policy determines what's recorded' -- clearly 'what is recorded' (present tense), not 'what has recorded' which would be ungrammatical here. Expanding it changes nothing about meaning.

notes: The single sentence-length-descriptive finding is disputed as an empirically-verified tool artifact: masking the markdown link destination breaks the sentence-splitter for the remainder of the paragraph, merging four short, correct sentences into one falsely 'overlong' one. The only genuine, safe defect (an unambiguous contraction) is accepted. Passage p1 records a segmentation defect found through this corpus and since fixed in the analyser; it is retained as the audit trail for that discovery.

candidateAdjudications.reason: 'where was it observed?' is another member of the same parallel list with the same event referent; the flagged alternatives are past participles, not selectable antecedents.
'from where was it initiated?' shares the single implied event referent of the surrounding bullets, so the pronoun is not open to a meaning-changing second reading.

'Each request can be recorded with an associated stage' is descriptive prose about apiserver behaviour, not an instruction; the actor is the audit subsystem and naming it would add nothing for the reader.

In 'before it is delegated down the handler chain', 'it' is the request just mentioned - the nearest noun and the only thing that traverses a handler chain. The audit event is a weak alternative but not a plausible one for a reader of this text.

Descriptive prose about internal request routing; the passage describes when a stage occurs rather than telling anyone to act, and the delegating component is an implementation detail the reader neither controls nor needs.
'Once the response headers are sent' marks a point in the server's own lifecycle; there is no instruction and no reader-relevant actor to promote.
'before the response body is sent' is the same kind of timing marker in descriptive prose about system behaviour, where the agent is genuinely irrelevant.
'This stage is only generated for long-running requests' states a property of the system, not an instruction; the generating component is the apiserver and naming it would not help the reader.
